summary: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to allow student support services programs to provide basic and emergency supplemental living assistance grants to students for anticipated and unanticipated expenses, with specific limits on emergency grant amounts and overall funding allocation.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to provide basic and emergency supplemental living assistance grants to students participating in student support services programs. This directly increases financial aid for students, which can be seen as a form of increased spending on public education, specifically higher education.
